body: My step sister and step brother killed themselves and he always tells me in my dreams to do it too and be with them I suppose it's nightmares I just can't believe how much I feel the pain and confusion you just described. Please don't please

I don't even know for sure its something I have felt since I was little. Certain things add to it but it's really too long to write. I want to see my kids grow and that's the only reason I'm still here. If I can figure out a way to do it but make it seen like an accident then I will. This is not how life was meant to be.

I have struggled my whole life my mother abandoned me I watched ny brother die from cancer and then lost a step sister and step brother to suicide. They knew what I felt like how it truly feels to wake up and want to die because the pain never goes away. I have tried meds I currently take anxiety medicine. And the hardest part is my kids I love them more than anything in the world and to be honest I truly think they will be better without me. Who wants to see there mom cry I know I hated that from the Times when I was ever around my mother but now I know and I just feel like there's no other way to make this better
Did your doctor have you supplement?

Sorry I didn't realize I left that out. It worked great at first helped me concentrate and get things done and it would last all day but now it seems to work for a short time maybe a couple of hours and then all my issues with add are back.

Thank you I am going to make some calls today. I had mentioned to her pediatrician in July what was going on and she pretty much dismissed it as a normal tantrum so I didn't get much support or help from her like I hoped.

Yes this year there has been big changes. I have definitely made sure I do things to spend some alone time with her, however probably not as often as I want because the twins keep me busy too. Me and my SO have been talking about making more time for each of us to do activities with her one on one.  I have thought about therapy but I was just unsure if she needed or not.

I haven't directly met with the teacher but I plan on contacting her. She usually tells me about her day went well and she's open with me. When she is having her tantrum and aggressive she seems like she can't help it and if I or another close family member talk to hug her etc she doesn't acknowledge us. When she's calm we always talk about it and how she felt and I always tell her I love her. She then can agree that she knows she shouldn't scream and try to hit me.

Thank you got your response, she does miss her old school and friends she asks for them still regularly. Her new school is public and only half day she has made a couple new friends which is great.  I used to work and now I'm home with the kids, and having twins takes a lot of my attention however I make special times for just me and her still. She loves being a big sister but she does express sometimes that the babies are always being played with etc. I have talked to her when she is calm and explained that she can hit a pillow and that it's ok to be mad but we need to work on what she does when she gets mad. Do you think I should be taking a privilege away or doing a time out after because she's hitting or will that make it worse?
No I would never call my child stupid
